brand.name: PT Launch Lab
brand.tagline: The only PT course run by gym owners who actually hire trainers
brand.category: UK personal trainer qualification (NCFE Level 2 + Level 3, Ofqual regulated)

color_usage_rules.background_default: Dark navy #072B4A or #051D33 — almost never anything else
color_usage_rules.headline_text: White (#FFFFFF) for body headlines, gold (#F5C518) for hero accent words
color_usage_rules.cta_button_outline: White or gold border with white text on dark bg
color_usage_rules.accent_lines_borders: Gold #F5C518 at 40-60% opacity, OR blue #3B82F6 at 20-30%
color_usage_rules.avoid: Light backgrounds, gradients other than dark-navy-to-darker, neon colours, generic Facebook blue

typography.display_font: Barlow Condensed (extra-bold weight, tight tracking) — for all headlines and hero text
typography.body_font: Poppins (medium / semibold) — for body copy and supporting text
rules: Headlines: Barlow Condensed, weight 800, tracking tight, leading near-zero
Eyebrows (small caps above headlines): Poppins, weight 700, tracking widest, uppercase, gold colour
Avoid: serif fonts, decorative fonts, light weights for headlines

visual_identity.logo_treatment: PT Launch Lab logo (small, top-left of frame, max 80px height in 1080x1920). Logo is white-on-transparent — works on dark navy.

preferred: Real candid photography — natural lighting, slight imperfection, mobile-phone feel
Domestic environments (kitchen, sofa, car interior) for relatability
Gym-floor reality shots (low-light, no influencer staging)
Founder photos (Callum / Miles / Ryan — assets at /callum.webp /miles.webp /ryan.webp)
avoid: Stock photography of shredded models with chrome dumbbells

voice_and_tone.persona: Gym-owner authority. Honest, no hype. Anti-£29-weekend-course. Built by people who've been on the hiring side of the desk.
principles: Identity-first, not feature-first ('You want X' before 'We do Y')
Direct, plain English — no jargon, no marketing speak
Honesty over hype — 'Most PTs fail in 18 months' is a stronger opener than 'Become a successful PT'
Anti-scarcity — call it 'Priority Intake Incentive', not 'HURRY 48 HOURS'
voice_examples_dos: Stuck in a job you've outgrown?
You don't hate working hard. You hate building somebody else's future.
The only PT course run by gym owners who actually hire trainers.
Most PT courses give you a certificate. Then leave you stuck.
Real route into PT. No degree. No fluff.
voice_examples_donts: DM us NOW to secure your spot

trust_signals: Real partner gyms (Ultimate Shred, 6Fit, Ironwolf, MOF, etc.)

audience_avatars.label: Gym Starter
audience_avatars.primary_hook: You're already in the gym anyway — so why are you still in a job you hate?

audience_avatars.label: Career Switcher
audience_avatars.tone: honest, no-nonsense, transitional — believable exit from a salary
audience_avatars.primary_hook: You don't hate working hard. You hate building somebody else's future.

audience_avatars.label: Returner / Parent
audience_avatars.tone: warm, soft, kind. Do NOT over-produce. NO gym-bro energy.
audience_avatars.primary_hook: Ready for something that's yours again?
